summary.name: FXMacroData
summary.one_liner: A macroeconomic and FX data service offering official-source economic releases, release calendars, central bank rates and market consensus forecasts for 22 currencies via a REST API and hosted MCP server.
use_cases: Track inflation, growth and employment history for research
Feed central bank rate and macro releases into trading or analysis tools
Give AI assistants access to economic data via MCP
Compare market consensus with realised economic announcements
Build apps or newsletters that display macro data with attribution
Check release timing and data coverage before subscribing
summary.what_it_does: The service provides official-source macroeconomic releases and history for 22 currencies, covering indicators such as inflation, growth, employment and policy rates. Data is served through a REST API and dashboards, with release calendars and streams. A predictions endpoint returns market consensus, survey, central-bank, IMF and FXMacroData forecast rows joined to realised announcements. A hosted MCP server lets AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor query the data. The page states that USD data works without a key, and that coverage and history start dates vary by currency and indicator.
notable: Hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants
Market consensus and forecast endpoint joined to realised announcements
USD data available without an API key
Same data and 1,000,000 API requests a month on both paid plans
caveats: Paid plans: Individual USD 50/month, Business USD 250/month, after a 14-day trial that requires a payment method
Commercial redistribution is a paid add-on starting at USD 10/month per audience block; raw resale and API pass-through are not included
Coverage and history depth vary by currency and indicator, so the series needed must be checked first
